description: This file defines an abstract class 'VirtualInput' for handling virtual input axes and buttons, including registration, deregistration, and position setting, within the Unity Standard Assets cross-platform input system.

classes.name: VirtualInput
classes.description: Abstract base class providing methods to manage virtual input axes and buttons, including registration, deregistration, and position updates.

methods.name: AxisExists
methods.description: Check if a virtual axis with the specified name exists.

methods.name: ButtonExists
methods.description: Check if a virtual button with the specified name exists.

methods.name: RegisterVirtualAxis
methods.description: Register a new virtual axis.

methods.name: RegisterVirtualButton
methods.description: Register a new virtual button.

methods.name: UnRegisterVirtualAxis
methods.description: Unregister an existing virtual axis by name.

methods.name: UnRegisterVirtualButton
methods.description: Unregister an existing virtual button by name.

methods.name: VirtualAxisReference
methods.description: Retrieve a reference to a virtual axis by name.

methods.name: SetVirtualMousePositionX
methods.description: Set the virtual mouse position's X coordinate.

methods.name: SetVirtualMousePositionY
methods.description: Set the virtual mouse position's Y coordinate.

methods.name: SetVirtualMousePositionZ
methods.description: Set the virtual mouse position's Z coordinate.

methods.name: GetAxis
methods.description: Abstract method to get the value of an axis.

methods.name: GetButton
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a button is held.

methods.name: GetButtonDown
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a button was pressed this frame.

methods.name: GetButtonUp
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a button was released this frame.

methods.name: SetButtonDown
methods.description: Abstract method to simulate button press.

methods.name: SetButtonUp
methods.description: Abstract method to simulate button release.

methods.name: SetAxisPositive
methods.description: Abstract method to set axis to positive direction.

methods.name: SetAxisNegative
methods.description: Abstract method to set axis to negative direction.

methods.name: SetAxisZero
methods.description: Abstract method to reset axis to zero.

methods.name: SetAxis
methods.description: Abstract method to set axis to a specific value.

methods.name: MousePosition
methods.description: Abstract method to get current mouse position.
